svg.title: The gate loop: from candidate to accepted work
svg.desc: Detailed review and correction loop showing how the Lead freezes a candidate, dispatches an independent verifier, dispositions findings, and decides among PASS, REVISE, and BLOCKED.
svg.text: The gate loop: from candidate to accepted work
Detailed review and correction loop showing how the Lead freezes a candidate, dispatches an independent verifier, dispositions findings, and decides among PASS, REVISE, and BLOCKED.

text.tspan: The review must name exactly what was reviewed, not
a moving workspace.
Artifact, revision, version, or content digest
Relevant dirty and untracked files
Checks already run, with evidence locations
Known limitations and unperformed checks
Confidence is not evidence. A claim becomes acceptance
only after inspection.
Observed, derived, hypothesised, unknown
Executed, supplied, proposed, unperformed
Producer report is a claim to evaluate
A verdict is not the Lead's acceptance

svg.text: Freeze the candidate + build the packet

text.tspan: Bind review to an exact candidate. Give the verifier requirements, context, evidence, known limits, scope,
and remaining budget — never steer toward a verdict.
A separate qualified agent or review session derives failure cases from the requirements, inspects or
probes, never edits the candidate, and discloses authorship conflicts.
criteria met; evidence sufficient
blocking defect requires change
cannot reach a defensible decision
Evaluate nonblocking findings, then accept only this candidate and
version. A PASS is not permission to merge or deploy, and it does not
transfer accountability.
Disposition each finding, assign corrections to the producer, preserve the failure
identity and cycle count, then freeze a new candidate for a new verdict.

svg.text: Never call a gap a pass

text.tspan: Missing authority, access, independence, a stable candidate, or
material evidence. Resolve it, ask the user, or pause. Strict gating
keeps the gate closed.
Run final checks on the combined result, deliver the PR/CI or record a
waiver, then report evidence and limits.
A correction starts a corrective cycle. The revised candidate receives its own
review; old evidence only covers the old version.
Record the blocker, the approaches tried, and the decision needed. Pause
dependent work when pause-on-fatal is on.
Failed, blocked, or unperformed gates stop acceptance. Any
exception is an explicit, recorded user decision.
Report unresolved findings and gaps. Findings inform the decision;
only substantive unmet criteria still block.
Specialist review is optional. Ordinary correctness checks,
acceptance criteria, and truthful reporting still apply.
At most 20 corrective cycles after the initial attempt. Count
when the attempt starts; renaming does not reset it.

svg.text: Diagram 3 of 3 · The gate and correction loop. A verdict is an input to the Lead's decision, not the decision itself.
